prompt:
A single professional logo lockup for a software platform named "Rangkita", an Indonesian SaaS platform that hosts several applications for Islamic education institutions (Quran memorization houses, schools). Flat vector brand identity, centered on a clean solid white background with generous padding. ONE logo only — not a grid, not variations, not a collage, not a mockup.

CONCEPT — "merangkai" (to weave together): the emblem is a single continuous ribbon or cord that loops and interlocks with itself into a compact, balanced knot-like mark, suggesting many separate things woven into one whole. Geometric, made of smooth rounded strokes of even thickness, with clear negative space in the middle. Abstract and modern — NOT a literal rope, NOT a mosque, NOT a book, NOT a person.

WORDMARK: the single word "Rangkita" below the emblem, in a confident geometric sans-serif with slightly rounded terminals, medium-bold weight, comfortable letter spacing, perfectly spelled.

COLOR: deep emerald teal as the primary color for both emblem and wordmark. A soft warm sand-gold used only as a small secondary accent on one segment of the ribbon. Absolutely NO navy blue, NO dark blue. Calm, trustworthy, contemporary.

STYLE: flat design, solid fills, no gradients, no drop shadows, no 3D, no textures, no outlines around the whole logo. Crisp vector edges. Must stay legible and recognizable when scaled down to a 16px favicon.

STRICT: no people, no hands, no faces, no Arabic calligraphy, no crescent moon, no star, no photographic elements, no background pattern, no extra text, no tagline, no registered trademark symbol.
quality_reason: Aset identitas merek, wordmark harus tajam dan ejaan tepat
